title: First hire plan
intro: A short plan for your first hire: what the role must achieve, how you'll find and choose someone fairly, what you'll offer and how you'll support them once they start. Share it with a co-founder, mentor or advisor before you post the job.

fields.label: Company or project name
fields.help: Use your working name if you haven't registered a company yet, for example the name on your landing page.

fields.label: The role
fields.help: A plain title plus why you need it now, for example 'Customer support lead, because support takes 15 hours of founder time a week'.

fields.label: Outcomes this person owns within six months
fields.help: Results you could check, not tasks, for example 'Every customer gets a first reply within four working hours'.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Every customer gets a first reply within four working hours

fields.label: Must-have skills
fields.help: Three to five skills needed from day one that your process will actually test, for example 'Writes clear, calm replies to upset customers'.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Writes clear, calm replies to upset customers

fields.label: Nice-to-have skills
fields.help: Skills that would help but that you could teach, for example 'Has used a help desk tool before'.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Has used a help desk tool before

fields.label: Where you'll find candidates
fields.help: Name specific places, including at least one outside your own network, for example 'Our user community, a regional customer support group and the local university careers service'.

fields.label: How you'll assess them
fields.help: List the steps, the core questions everyone gets and a short paid work sample, for example 'Screening call, paid 90-minute sample answering five real emails, interview, two reference calls'.

fields.label: Compensation approach
fields.help: Give a pay range and, in general terms, whether you'll offer equity and how it would vest, for example 'Local market salary range, plus options vesting over four years, plan to be set up with a lawyer'.

fields.label: The first 30 days
fields.help: A short plan, week by week, for example 'Week 1: shadow the founder on support and read the last 200 customer emails'.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Week 1: shadow the founder and read the last 200 customer emails

fields.label: How you'll give feedback
fields.help: Say how often you'll hold one-on-ones and how you'll give and ask for feedback, for example 'Weekly 30-minute one-on-one with their topics first, and feedback within a day of anything important'.
